scope.excluded_work: all catalog problems and research tracks other than #021/B7, #022/B2, and #023

question: Can the publicly frozen two-pass correlation-aware decoder make the unchanged 71-active-qubit distance-6 memory pass the same strict X/Z verifier that rejected independent MWPM?

execution.challenge_seed_derivation: lower 63 bits of the first eight SHA-256 bytes of UTF8(salt) || 0x00 || coordinate-canonical Stim circuit bytes

kaggle_inspired_verification_contract.source: Google Quantum AI - Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation competition overview and evaluation metric, consulted 2026-11-20
kaggle_inspired_verification_contract.correctness_before_cost: a candidate that fails either strict basis verifier receives score zero
kaggle_inspired_verification_contract.reference_relative_cost: each basis improvement is reference active-qubit-rounds divided by candidate active-qubit-rounds
kaggle_inspired_verification_contract.geometric_mean_aggregation: combine X and Z basis improvements by their geometric mean
kaggle_inspired_verification_contract.submission_bound_randomness: derive fresh seeds from a public-freeze-bound salt and canonical candidate bytes
kaggle_inspired_verification_contract.reproducibility: publish the protocol, exact chunk digests, independent confidence audit, and deterministic stochastic replay
kaggle_inspired_verification_contract.adaptation_boundary: this is a QEC memory benchmark inspired by the competition's verification design, not an entry in its three circuit-compilation tasks

score_contract.composite_score: Score_QEC=sqrt(I_X*I_Z) after both bases strictly verify; otherwise 0

timing_contract.baseline: frozen independent-MWPM execution on the same host and toolchain
timing_contract.report: correlated decode seconds per shot and correlated/independent decode-time ratio by basis
timing_contract.status: diagnostic only because no hardware decoder deadline has been declared

downstream_gates.b2_physical_memory_candidate_gate: both strict basis gates and Score_QEC>=1.25; full B2 credit remains closed pending decoder timing, mismatch robustness, and implementation constraints
downstream_gates.p023_scalable_memory: remains false without strict direct million-round X/Z evidence, drift/correlation stress, and a declared decoder deadline
downstream_gates.b7_resource_credit: remains zero until B2, #023, calibrated dependency, layout, and architecture gates pass
